entities.summary: The Basilica of St. John the Baptist also called Basilica of St. John the Baptist Patron of Breslavia is the Catholic cathedral seat of the Military Ordinariate of Germany. The church is located in the quarter of Neukölln in Berlin, next to the Holy See's Apostolic Nunciature.
